request.query: For real M and kprime < k, eventually for natural q M / q^k < 1 / q^kprime

items.name: NNReal.eventually_pow_one_div_le
items.type: ∀ (x : NNReal) {y : NNReal}, 1 < y → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, x ^ (1 / ↑n) ≤ y

items.name: Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_pow_atTop_of_lt
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [OrderTopology 𝕜] {p q : ℕ},
  p < q → (fun x => x ^ p) =o[Filter.atTop] fun x => x ^ q

items.name: tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt
items.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) {r : ℝ}, 1 < r → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n ^ k / r ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

items.name: PadicInt.exists_pow_neg_lt
items.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∃ k, ↑p ^ (-↑k) < ε

items.name: ENNReal.eventually_pow_one_div_le
items.type: ∀ {x : ENNReal}, x ≠ ⊤ → ∀ {y : ENNReal}, 1 < y → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, x ^ (1 / ↑n) ≤ y

items.name: LiouvilleWith.frequently_lt_rpow_neg
items.type: ∀ {p q x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → q < p → ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ m, x ≠ ↑m / ↑n ∧ |x - ↑m / ↑n| < ↑n ^ (-q)

items.name: padicValRat.pow
items.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {q : ℚ}, q ≠ 0 → ∀ {k : ℕ}, padicValRat p (q ^ k) = ↑k * padicValRat p q
